attempts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: one 16:9 cinema keyframe for GeoSR's marine environmental research website and future company film
Reference image: mood and material reference only, not a GeoSR facility photograph
Create a beautifully photographed, people-free seawater chemistry laboratory still. A quiet graphite laboratory bench, three closed borosilicate sample bottles with restrained cobalt caps and clear water, a small rack of clear sample vials, and one closed sample-compartment UV-visible spectrophotometer in the right background. This is the sample-preparation stage, not an instrument measuring with an open lid
Composition: low bench-height three-quarter view with the analytical instrument and samples in the right two thirds, understated clear negative space in the left third for website text. Different bottle distances create real optical depth. Soft cool daylight from an off-frame window and a subtle warmer edge on glass, highly realistic glass thickness, menisci and grounded shadows. No visible coastal scenery through windows. Editorial scientific photography, restrained navy and neutral materials, believable premium research laboratory rather than a futuristic render. Crisp subject, natural shallow depth of field, no excessive blur
All caps and vessels have coherent geometry. No microscope, no vacuum filtration tubing, no decorative laboratory clutter. No hands, people, generated writing, logos, display numbers, glowing liquids, blue neon or fake graph. Produce only ONE full landscape frame, not a storyboard sheet or split view. Preserve true 16:9 if available
The image is a generated concept, not evidence of a real facility or analytical result

attempts.prompt:

The objective is close to the coverslip at a credible working distance. A small closed sample bottle and a covered shallow sample dish can remain softly in the rear, not a cluttered collection. The laboratory is clean but used, graphite bench and neutral white microscope body, restrained blue details, natural window sidelight. Left third is dark and quiet for web copy. Realistic machined metal, lens coatings and optical glass, natural depth of field, not a futuristic rendering
This is an establishing frame for a slow macro camera move toward the slide. No visible people or hands. No hovering slide, impossible lens arrangement, giant organisms, generated species imagery, labels, numbers, holograms, blue neon or text. ONE continuous full landscape image, no collage. A generic research concept, not a photograph claimed to depict the company's exact instrument

attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: a single cinematic underwater research film keyframe, landscape 16:9
Reference image is the exact ROV identity and front-facing geometry to preserve. Place this same compact blue and black ROV in a realistic Korean temperate coastal underwater environment. Preserve its two pale-blue top buoyancy blocks, central clear cylindrical camera dome, black open structural frame, visible thruster layout and lower rectangular instrument shown in the source. Composition: the ROV occupies the right half, suspended approximately one metre above a gently textured sand and small stone seabed; quiet darker water on the left third for text. Moderately turbid green-blue water, realistic attenuation and sparse suspended particles, restrained white task-light illumination only nearby. Upper corners of the frame reveal a subtle overhead water glow, not visible sky. A single orange tether recedes from the obscured rear of the vehicle toward the upper-right and out of frame with a smooth modest slack curve; it does not attach to the camera dome or pass through the front frame. This is a static inspection moment, no bubbles or jet propulsion effects
Natural underwater engineering photography, very precise materials, no tropical corals, no schools of fish, no wreck fantasy, no people, no blue scanning laser, no generated text or logos. One full 16:9 frame, not a collage. This is a source-referenced generated concept, not an actual operation photograph

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct only the microscope optics in the supplied image while preserving the composition, microscope body, same stage, closed bottle, background, quiet left third and photographic lighting. The active vertical objective is currently too far above the coverslip and has an unrealistic bright glowing tip. Move the mechanical stage and condenser upward together so that the coverslip sits approximately 0.5 millimetres below the central objective front lens, with a tiny visible air gap, no contact with the glass. Keep the slide completely flat and supported by the stage. The condenser remains underneath. Replace the bright golden flare at the objective tip with faint neutral transmitted illumination confined to the specimen window beneath the slide. No starburst, glowing tip or visible laser beam. Remove invented or unreadable lettering from the objective barrels, keep only their small conventional coloured identification bands. All three objectives must stay rigidly attached to the same nosepiece and the central one remains precisely vertical above the slide. Do not add any apparatus, hands, people, giant cells or glowing organisms. One realistic landscape 16:9 macro laboratory photograph, generic concept apparatus rather than the company's exact model. Keep geometry physically credible.
